name: Hike plan from a reel
summary: A shared hike reel becomes a plan: the trail's climb, everyone's comfort level picking the route, car seats and a lock.
useWhen: someone shares a hike or trail reel and asks 'can we do this'
a day outing where how hard it is matters and people need rides
dontUseWhen: just picking a date (use a date poll)
rides only, no route question (use event-carpool)

params.comfort: {name, level 0-2}[] already said in the chat
params.cars: {name, driver, seats 2-7 incl. driver, riders: names}[] 0-3
